$comment: Vortex-agent QA manifest — declares how THIS repo is QA'd. Read by the reconciler; keeps the agent core repo-agnostic.

web.previewDeploy: From apps/backend: `bunx convex deploy --preview-create "$VORTEX_PREVIEW_NAME" --cmd-url-env-var-name VITE_CONVEX_URL --cmd 'cd ../web && bun run build'` (deploys an isolated preview backend and builds apps/web pointed at it). Then from apps/web: `bunx wrangler versions upload` — this prints a public preview URL. Drive browserless at that URL.
